title: Andy CLI layered configuration v1
description: Schema for andy.jsonc, the layered CLI configuration file (rivoli-ai/andy-cli#280). Sources are merged in the order packaged defaults < user (~/.andy/andy.jsonc) < project (<workspace>/andy.jsonc then <workspace>/.andy/andy.jsonc) < environment < CLI arguments. Unknown keys are rejected with source, line, column and key path. See docs/configuration.md.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint. Ignored by the loader.

version.description: Configuration schema version. Bump introduces a new schema file (andy-config.v2.json) plus an explicit compatibility layer; do not overload v1.

llm.description: Provider and model selection. Merged per field; 'providers' is a keyed map merged entry by entry.

defaultProvider.description: Provider id or alias used when nothing overrides it (see ProviderRegistry). Empty string is rejected; omit the key instead.

defaultModel.description: Model id used for the default provider when nothing overrides it.

providers.description: Per-provider settings keyed by provider name. Keys merge across layers; a later layer only replaces the fields it declares.

provider.description: Underlying provider implementation id when the map key is an alias (e.g. key 'openai/codex' -> provider 'openai').

apiKey.description: API key. Prefer {env:NAME}; the resolved value is never printed.

model.description: Default model id for this provider entry.

enabled.description: Whether the entry is offered. Defaults to true.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers. Values are always redacted in effective-config output.

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol servers for interactive mode.

servers.description: Servers keyed by name. Keys merge across layers; within a server, 'args' REPLACES (it is never concatenated) while 'env' and 'headers' merge key by key.

enabled.description: Whether the server is started. Defaults to true.

url.description: Absolute http(s) MCP endpoint. Required for HTTP transports.

command.description: Executable for stdio transport. Started directly, without a shell.

args.description: Ordered argument list. Replaced wholesale by a higher-precedence layer.

workingDirectory.description: Child-process working directory. A relative path is resolved against the directory of the file that declared it.

env.description: Environment variables for the child process.

headers.description: HTTP headers. Values are always redacted in effective-config output.

theme.description: Theme name (see /theme). Unknown names fall back to the built-in default at render time.

transparentBackground.description: Let the terminal background show through instead of painting the theme background.

diffStyle.description: Diff layout. 'auto' (default) picks side-by-side on wide terminals. Equivalent to ANDY_DIFF_STYLE.

directory.description: Directory holding saved sessions. Defaults to ~/.andy/sessions. A relative path is resolved against the directory of the file that declared it.

maxTurns.description: Hard cap on agent-loop turns before the run stops. Equivalent to ANDY_MAX_TURNS. Omit to keep the built-in default.

permissions.description: Tool-permission behaviour. The permission RULES themselves stay in the dedicated permissions.json security format; only the mode is configurable here. The resolved rule-file locations are reported by 'andy-cli config show --effective'.

mode.description: 'ask' prompts for tools that need approval (default). 'auto' approves them without prompting and is equivalent to ANDY_AUTO_APPROVE / --auto / --yolo.

console.description: Attach the console logger. Equivalent to ANDY_DEBUG=true. Off by default because console output corrupts the TUI.
